# Naturo Group — robots policy
# Allow all reputable crawlers. Sitemap is generated by @astrojs/sitemap.

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# our marketing copy. Comment any line out if you change your mind.
User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: ChatGPT-User
Disallow: /

User-agent: CCBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: anthropic-ai
Disallow: /

User-agent: Google-Extended
Disallow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Amazonbot
Disallow: /
